case_facts.orca-image-build-003: Local named base image build succeeded.
case_facts.resource-001: Two 600MiB children shared a 1GiB cgroup; oom_kill=1, peak=1GiB; surviving parent reaped both. Whole-group OOM and parent hard-death cleanup not proven.
